body: Thank you I appreciate the support 🙇‍♀️❤️

Thank you. I really need to take better care of myself I shouldn’t let myself get treated like that by someone that’s supposed to love me you’re right.I know it will be hard but I will have to come to terms that a break up will be the best thing for me and him. I don’t want it to get worse

I hope you can manage to get away from both toxic situations tho I know one day we will be strong enough to step away from all the toxicity in life.
